visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short, styled brown hair and round glasses sits on a light brown sofa. She wears a black sleeveless top and several beaded bracelets on her left wrist. The background is a clean, neutral-toned wall. She initially looks down, then looks directly into the lens with a friendly, professional expression. (2) As the woman speaks, a cutaway appears showing a close-up of a skin procedure. Hands in white latex gloves use a medical needle to carefully pierce a red, inflamed pustule on a person's skin, followed by a small amount of blood and pus emerging against the pale skin. (3) The scene returns to the woman gesturing actively with both hands to emphasize her points. She then holds up a white jar of "DRX" skin treatment pads. She demonstrates the application process by touching her own cheek area where a user would apply the product. (4) The final frame is a clean white graphic background displaying the clinic's logo "DRX Dermatology Clinic" in dark text. Social media handles, phone numbers, and two physical address locations in New Taipei City and Taipei City are listed clearly in a structured, static format.
